# struct kinfo_proc of <sys/sysctl.h> / <sys/proc.h> on 64-bit Apple targets and the sysctl constants of the debugger
# check (src/risk/apple.rs), as tests/c-abi/kinfo_layout.c prints them. Measured with the macOS SDK of the
# CommandLineTools (MacOSX15.5.sdk, arm64). tools/c-abi-smoke.sh compares this file with the SDK of the host; the
# unit test kinfo_proc_constants_are_the_measured_ones compares it with the Rust constants.
sizeof_kinfo_proc=648
offsetof_p_flag=32
offsetof_p_pid=40
P_TRACED=2048
CTL_KERN=1
KERN_PROC=14
KERN_PROC_PID=1
